lines.zh: 沙粒在我脚跟下碎成粉。
lines.en: The sand grinds to powder under my heels.

lines.zh: 我拖着步子，骨头里灌满了沙。
lines.en: I drag my steps, sand packed inside my bones.

lines.zh: 每一步都离你近一寸。
lines.en: Every step brings me one inch closer to you.

lines.zh: 壳甲摩擦，像砂纸磨着石头。
lines.en: My shell plates rasp like sandpaper on stone.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，可从不改方向。
lines.en: I walk slowly, but I never change direction.

lines.zh: 白眼睛替我照路，不用火把。
lines.en: White eyes light my path; I need no torch.

lines.zh: 风把我的脚印一点点填平。
lines.en: The wind fills my footprints in behind me.

lines.zh: 我在夜里走，白天也走。
lines.en: I walk at night, and I walk in daylight too.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸声，我隔着沙丘就听见。
lines.en: I hear your breathing across the dunes.

lines.zh: 这具皮囊比你以为的沉。
lines.en: This hide is heavier than you think.

lines.zh: 沙漠记得我，我却不记得它。
lines.en: The desert remembers me; I don't remember it.

lines.zh: 我在你身后走了很久了。
lines.en: I have walked behind you for a long while.

lines.zh: 沙子钻进喉咙，我懒得咳。
lines.en: Sand gets in my throat; I don't bother coughing.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，像半截埋进土里的柱子。
lines.en: I stand still, like a post half-buried in earth.

lines.zh: 脑子里的声音一直没停。
lines.en: The voice in my skull never stops.

lines.zh: 我在数你还有多少口气。
lines.en: I am counting how many breaths you have left.

lines.zh: 这片沙丘归我守着。
lines.en: I keep watch over these dunes.

lines.zh: 我又忘了我为什么站着。
lines.en: I forget again why I am standing here.

lines.zh: 皮肤干得能刮下粉来。
lines.en: My skin is so dry it flakes into dust.

lines.zh: 太阳晒不化我，只把我晒得更硬。
lines.en: The sun can't melt me; it only bakes me harder.

lines.zh: 你走你的，我看着。
lines.en: You go your way; I'll watch.

lines.zh: 我连眼皮都不用眨。
lines.en: I don't even need to blink.

lines.zh: 那双眼白得像淬过火。
lines.en: These eyes are white as quenched iron.

lines.zh: 我看见你了，从你出生那天起。
lines.en: I've seen you since the day you were born.

lines.zh: 你背后的影子动了一下。
lines.en: The shadow behind you just moved.

lines.zh: 别回头，我就在那儿。
lines.en: Don't turn around; I'm right there.

lines.zh: 这张脸你认得吗？
lines.en: Do you recognize this face?

lines.zh: 我盯着你，像盯着一条裂缝。
lines.en: I stare at you like a crack in the ground.

lines.zh: 你眼里的光，我要收走。
lines.en: The light in your eyes — I'll take it.

lines.zh: 白瞳里没有倒影，只有你。
lines.en: No reflection in these white eyes, only you.

lines.zh: 我能听见你的心跳变快了。
lines.en: I can hear your heartbeat speed up.

lines.zh: 你抬头时，我正好看着你。
lines.en: When you look up, I'm already watching.

lines.zh: 壳甲裂了一道缝。
lines.en: A crack opened in my shell plate.

lines.zh: 这点疼，我早就不在乎了。
lines.en: Pain like that stopped mattering long ago.

lines.zh: 你打到的是沙，不是我。
lines.en: You struck sand, not me.

lines.zh: 骨头没断，还能打。
lines.en: Nothing's broken; I can still fight.

lines.zh: 我退半步，不是怕你。
lines.en: I gave half a step, not out of fear.

lines.zh: 血是黑的，别溅到你身上。
lines.en: My blood is black; don't let it touch you.

lines.zh: 这一剑砍进壳里了。
lines.en: That sword bit into my shell.

lines.zh: 我抖掉身上的沙，继续。
lines.en: I shake off the sand and continue.

lines.zh: 你手在抖，我看得清楚。
lines.en: Your hands are shaking; I can see it.

lines.zh: 白眼睛一暗，我反而站得更直。
lines.en: My white eyes dim, and I stand straighter than before.

lines.zh: 收起来吧，我不吃活人的东西。
lines.en: Put it away; I don't eat what the living offer.

lines.zh: 面包太软，牙口不配。
lines.en: Bread's too soft for teeth like mine.

lines.zh: 你举着胡萝卜，是想喂驴吗？
lines.en: You hold a carrot out — am I a donkey?

lines.zh: 腐肉才合我的胃，可惜你没有。
lines.en: Rotten flesh suits me, and you don't have any.

lines.zh: 我饿，但我更想咬你。
lines.en: I'm hungry, but I'd rather bite you.

lines.zh: 食物掩不住你身上的热气。
lines.en: Food can't hide the heat coming off you.

lines.zh: 别晃了，那点香味骗不了我。
lines.en: Stop waving it; that smell won't fool me.

lines.zh: 我尝过更甜的，是恐惧。
lines.en: I've tasted sweeter things: fear.

lines.zh: 你把饼递过来，我数你的手指。
lines.en: You offer cake; I count your fingers.

lines.zh: 这具身体早就不靠吃饭活着。
lines.en: This body stopped living on meals long ago.

lines.zh: 撞上来，你会被壳甲刮伤。
lines.en: Bump into me and my shell plates will scrape you.

lines.zh: 别贴这么近，我身上掉沙。
lines.en: Don't press so close; I shed sand.

lines.zh: 你推不动我，我比看着重。
lines.en: You can't shove me; I'm heavier than I look.

lines.zh: 让开，我走路不看人。
lines.en: Move; I don't watch where I walk.

lines.zh: 我的肩甲磕了你的肋骨。
lines.en: My shoulder plate knocked against your ribs.

lines.zh: 我的壳甲撞过去，沙落了你一身。
lines.en: My shell plate rams you, shaking sand all over your clothes.

lines.zh: 沙从我们中间漏下去。
lines.en: Sand leaks down between us.

lines.zh: 沙从我的壳缝里掉到你身上。
lines.en: Sand falls from the cracks in my shell onto you.

lines.zh: 我停不下来，惯性太大。
lines.en: I can't stop; too much momentum.

lines.zh: 退后三步，别蹭掉我的壳。
lines.en: Three steps back; don't rub off my shell.

lines.zh: 这具身体不会再有后代。
lines.en: This body will never produce offspring.

lines.zh: 她早就埋在沙下了。
lines.en: She was buried under the sand long ago.

lines.zh: 主人说，繁衍是活人的事。
lines.en: The master says breeding is for the living.

lines.zh: 沙丘下躺着我的整族人。
lines.en: My whole kin lies beneath these dunes.

lines.zh: 我闻不到伴侣，只闻到血。
lines.en: I smell no mate, only blood.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我心里没有那点火。
lines.en: Keep back; that fire is gone from me.

lines.zh: 我们这样的，只会越走越少。
lines.en: Creatures like us only grow fewer.

lines.zh: 空壳里只剩主人的声音。
lines.en: In this empty shell only the master's voice remains.

lines.zh: 爱这种东西，风化得比皮还快。
lines.en: Love weathers faster than skin out here.

lines.zh: 你要找伴，去村里，别在沙里找。
lines.en: Want a mate? Try a village, not the sand.

lines.zh: 我捡起你掉的铁剑，掂了掂。
lines.en: I pick up your dropped iron sword and weigh it.

lines.zh: 这顶头盔正好扣住我的角。
lines.en: This helmet fits right over my horns.

lines.zh: 骨头用不着护甲，但我喜欢。
lines.en: Bones don't need armor, but I like it.

lines.zh: 你掉的箭，我一根根收好。
lines.en: Your dropped arrows — I gather them one by one.

lines.zh: 捡东西时腰会响一声。
lines.en: My back cracks when I stoop to pick things up.

lines.zh: 这把镐子我拿去砸门。
lines.en: I'll use this pickaxe to break down a door.

lines.zh: 地上这枚金锭，主人会喜欢。
lines.en: The master will like this gold ingot on the ground.

lines.zh: 我把你的盾捡走了，别找了。
lines.en: I took your shield; stop looking for it.

lines.zh: 沙里埋的破布，我也要。
lines.en: Even the rag buried in sand, I'll take.

lines.zh: 手指太僵，捡了三次才夹住。
lines.en: My fingers are stiff; it took three tries to pinch it.

lines.zh: 有活物进了我的沙丘。
lines.en: Something living entered my dunes.

lines.zh: 主人指了方向，就在你那儿。
lines.en: The master points, and it's where you stand.

lines.zh: 三十五点血，够我玩很久。
lines.en: Thirty-five hit points — enough to play with for a while.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道太新鲜了。
lines.en: You smell far too fresh.

lines.zh: 风停了，我听见你的脚步。
lines.en: The wind died; I hear your footsteps.

lines.zh: 你不是第一个，也不会是最后一个。
lines.en: You're not the first, nor will you be the last.

lines.zh: 那双白眼睛锁住你了。
lines.en: Those white eyes have locked onto you.

lines.zh: 别跑，沙地跑不快。
lines.en: Don't run; sand is bad for running.

lines.zh: 我的壳甲挡得住你的箭。
lines.en: My shell plates will stop your arrows.

lines.zh: 这一带今晚只留一个活口。
lines.en: Only one of us stays alive here tonight.

lines.zh: 目标确认，心跳在左边。
lines.en: Target confirmed: heartbeat on the left.

lines.zh: 你挖的坑，正好给自己用。
lines.en: The hole you dug will do nicely for you.

lines.zh: 我闻到铁，也闻到汗。
lines.en: I smell iron, and I smell sweat.

lines.zh: 主人笑了，我就该动手了。
lines.en: The master laughed; time for me to move.

lines.zh: 脚步声停了，是你发现了。
lines.en: Your steps stopped, so you noticed.

lines.zh: 我一步一步压过去，不着急。
lines.en: I close in step by step, in no hurry.

lines.zh: 你退到哪儿，沙子都会告诉我。
lines.en: Wherever you retreat, the sand tells me.

lines.zh: 我的攻击六点，你的盾挡几次？
lines.en: My strike is six; how many blocks can your shield take?

lines.zh: 别躲树后，我照样看得见。
lines.en: Don't hide behind that tree; I see you anyway.

lines.zh: 你数着距离，我数着你的破绽。
lines.en: You count the distance; I count your openings.

lines.zh: 我抬手的时候，你就该跑了。
lines.en: When I raise this arm, you should already be running.

lines.zh: 这身壳甲不是为了好看。
lines.en: This shell armor isn't for looks.

lines.zh: 你身后是沙丘，前面是我。
lines.en: Dunes behind you, me in front.

lines.zh: 我等你先把箭射完。
lines.en: I'll wait until you've spent your arrows.

lines.zh: 尸壳不需要呼吸，追多久都行。
lines.en: Husks don't breathe; I can chase all day.

lines.zh: 沙粒正从我的皮上往下掉。
lines.en: Sand keeps dropping off my hide.

lines.zh: 我听见你换手拿剑了。
lines.en: I heard you switch the sword to your other hand.

lines.zh: 再近两步，你就进我胳膊了。
lines.en: Two steps closer and you're in my reach.

lines.zh: 主人要活的，我尽量轻点。
lines.en: The master wants you alive; I'll try to be gentle.

lines.zh: 我把沙拨开，让路更松。
lines.en: I scrape the sand so the going is softer.

lines.zh: 你往上坡跑，我不追，我等你。
lines.en: Run uphill; I will not chase, I will wait.

lines.zh: 我的壳甲暗得和夜一样。
lines.en: My shell is as dark as the night.

lines.zh: 你喘得很重，我听得很清楚。
lines.en: You pant heavily, and I hear it clearly.

lines.zh: 这一下，六点伤害，记住了。
lines.en: Six points of damage — remember that.

lines.zh: 沙子混着血，味道不错。
lines.en: Sand mixed with blood tastes fine.

lines.zh: 你的护甲挡不住这么重的手。
lines.en: Your armor can't stop a hand this heavy.

lines.zh: 我倒要看看你还能站几次。
lines.en: Let's see how many more times you can stand.

lines.zh: 骨头打骨头，声音真脆。
lines.en: Bone on bone makes such a crisp sound.

lines.zh: 我掐住你的时候别乱动。
lines.en: Don't squirm while I have you.

lines.zh: 这一拳是主人赏的。
lines.en: This blow is a gift from the master.

lines.zh: 你退了两步，血滴在沙上。
lines.en: You fell back two steps; blood drips on sand.

lines.zh: 我打人从来不用第二只手。
lines.en: I never need my other hand to hit.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖软了，我看见了。
lines.en: Your knees buckled; I saw it.

lines.zh: 壳甲蹭破你的肩膀了。
lines.en: My shell plate tore your shoulder open.

lines.zh: 疼吗？我早就不知道疼了。
lines.en: Does it hurt? I forgot pain long ago.

lines.zh: 再挨一下，你就该躺下了。
lines.en: One more and you'll be lying down.

lines.zh: 我出手重，是因为你值得。
lines.en: I hit hard because you're worth it.

lines.zh: 这一掌把你按回沙里。
lines.en: This palm presses you back into the sand.

lines.zh: 你的骨头响了一声，很好。
lines.en: One of your bones clicked; very good.

lines.zh: 沙丘裂开，我从下面爬出来。
lines.en: The dune splits; I climb out from beneath.

lines.zh: 夜风一起，我就站在这里了。
lines.en: The night wind rose, and here I stand.

lines.zh: 主人把我从沙里叫醒。
lines.en: The master woke me from the sand.

lines.zh: 这里以前埋着一支商队。
lines.en: A caravan was buried here once.

lines.zh: 沙子还挂在我的肋骨上。
lines.en: Sand still clings to my ribs.

lines.zh: 我回来时，村子已经空了。
lines.en: When I came back, the village was empty.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛先亮，然后才是身体。
lines.en: My eyes lit first, then the rest of me.

lines.zh: 这一带又多了一个守夜的。
lines.en: This stretch has one more night watchman now.

lines.zh: 我从沙暴里走出来。
lines.en: I walked out of the sandstorm.

lines.zh: 三十五点血，四点护甲，够用了。
lines.en: Thirty-five health, four armor — that'll do.

lines.zh: 别问我从哪来，沙子不记路。
lines.en: Don't ask where I'm from; sand keeps no roads.

lines.zh: 我又被派到这片荒地。
lines.en: I've been posted to this wasteland again.

lines.zh: 主人的白眼睛在云后面。
lines.en: The master's white eyes are behind the clouds.

lines.zh: 站稳了，沙子还在往下掉。
lines.en: Steady; sand is still falling off me.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的壳，像烧陶。
lines.en: Fire bakes my shell like pottery.

lines.zh: 落地时我听见自己裂开。
lines.en: I heard myself crack when I landed.

lines.zh: 水灌进空腔，我沉下去。
lines.en: Water fills my hollow chest; I sink.

lines.zh: 炸飞了半片壳甲。
lines.en: Half my shell plate blew away.

lines.zh: 箭卡在骨缝里，正好当装饰。
lines.en: An arrow's stuck in my ribs — fine decoration.

lines.zh: 药水在我血管里冒烟。
lines.en: Potion smoke rises in my veins.

lines.zh: 饿到骨头互相磨。
lines.en: Hunger grinds bone against bone.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我更硬了。
lines.en: Lightning struck; I came out harder.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有沙丘，我只能一直下坠。
lines.en: No dunes in the void; I can only keep falling.
